items.html: Now, these three phases rose by the secret of Ibur [impregnation], in the three phases of Ima. How so? In the place of the record of the Yesod of Bina, the lights rose there. And in the middle place, the place of the cut, the 288 sparks of light rose there. And in the place of the Yesod of Tvuna, the vessels rose. And know that these three phases are from what our sages said, that there are three chambers in the woman — three months in the lower chamber, etc. — and this will be explained well in the coming chapters.
